reviews.title: Stunning Color, Easy Installation, and Plenty of Compliments!
reviews.comment: I couldn't be happier with the Thermaltake SWAFAN EX 14 ARGB fans. From the moment I installed them, they have been an absolute standout addition to my build — and everyone who has seen my setup has had nothing but compliments about how good they look. The white colorway is crisp and clean, and the ARGB lighting takes it to another level entirely. Inside my case, the colors pop beautifully and really tie the whole build together. Whether cycling through colors or locked onto a specific theme, these fans look fantastic and add that premium aesthetic that really makes a build stand out. What really surprised me though was how straightforward the wiring process was. I was a little nervous going in, expecting the usual cable management headache that comes with RGB fans, but the SWAFAN EX 14 made it so much easier than I anticipated. Everything was well organized and the connectors were intuitive, which made the whole installation process smooth and stress-free. On top of the looks, the fans run quietly and perform well across the 500~2000 RPM range, giving me solid cooling without any distracting noise. If you're looking for PC fans that deliver on aesthetics, ease of installation, and reliable performance, the Thermaltake SWAFAN EX 14 ARGB in white is an excellent choice. Highly recommended — my build has never looked better!

reviews.title: Great fans
reviews.comment: Great fans for finishing out my build love the fact you have the choice of reverse or forward blades at your disposal your not locked in to where you can put these they are the most versatile fan I have used in 18 years I have been building pcs A bit steep on the price but you do get both sets of blades so you have to decide if this is what you want They are quiet at 50% never had them at a higher rpm due to using them in a water cooled rig I like the fact that they push enough volume of air it’s not a problem for me keeping my temps in check LEDs are nice and bright light up my system beautifully
reviews.author: Steven

reviews.title: Nice fans.
reviews.comment: These were kind of pricey, but I love the fact that they daisy chain without a separate cable to each fan. I have 9 fans in my case and only 4 cables attached to my motherboard. No splitters and no extra cables. I have had them for 8 or 9 months and they run almost constantly. The LEDs work well with the ASUS native controls and they are very quiet most of the time. When they all spin up (usually only in the summer) it gets a bit noisy, but better than some I've heard. They were super easy to install, but be sure that you have them aligned properly. The magnets can sometimes connect without connecting the electrical components. Finally, they are fans, and they move air as they should.
reviews.author: R G

reviews.title: Good budget Lian Li alternative with a bit fiddly install
reviews.comment: Very decent and cheaper alternative to the Lian Li stuff. I really like the swapable fan idea because it came in handy. They do function well if not a bit loud compared to Lian li but not annoying. The system feels well built and look decent for the price. The only thing that gives pause is the install which is a bit fiddly and goofy as well as the fan stickers not being centered so the look wobbly (I removed them later). Key take away, harder to install but they do work and are usually waaay cheaper than Lian Li. I can recommend for more budget minded setups. Edit: I have since removed these fans to put in a different case. They are still good fans I just wanted an all Lian Li setup to get away from Msi Mystic Light and at the time there were literally no Lian Li 140mm reverse blade fans available or hardly any reverse blade daisy chain fans available until I saw these. These came in clutch with their fan swap system.
